name: fresh-editor 0.5.3
body:
## 0.5.3

For live updates on Fresh, [follow me on X](https://x.com/TheNoamLewis).

> Most config options below can be changed in the **Settings UI** - run **Open Settings** from the command palette (`Ctrl+P`).

### Features

* **Find Next selects the whole match** - F3 / Shift+F3 select the entire match, and the current match is highlighted in its own color
* **Theme text attributes** - any theme color accepts bold, italic or underline, e.g. to draw diagnostics as underlines (#3494, requested by @zeevro)
* **Theme color fallbacks** - colors a theme omits are derived from its other colors. Complete user themes may look slightly different after upgrading; see [Themes → Fallbacks](https://getfresh.dev/docs/features/themes#fallbacks)
* **Full internationalization of the Settings UI** - setting names, descriptions and categories are translated in all locales (#3479 by @neatsorg)
* **Import coding agent and terminal sessions in Orchestrator**
  - Claude and Codex sessions running outside Fresh are listed in the dock, grouped by product
  - Open a session as a workspace, or fork a cloud session into one
  - **Move to Folder** files workspaces and sessions into folders, by click or drag
* **File Explorer** (#3427, requested by @akarinotomoshibi)
  - Drag and drop to move files and folders
  - Rename accepts a path, which moves the entry
  - Dropping a file asks for confirmation before moving it, and the move is animated
  - Refresh button
* **Weather location and units** can be set for the dashboard plugin (#3344 by @KyleKorndoerfer)
* **Kotlin uses JetBrains' official `kotlin-lsp`** by default; set `lsp.kotlin.command` to keep `kotlin-language-server` (#3481 by @karczews)
* **Plugin docs** - the [API reference](https://getfresh.dev/docs/plugins/api/) is generated from the source, and there is a new "Asking for Input" guide

### Bug Fixes

* **`AutoOpenDock` honored, with `auto` / `always` / `never` values** - opening or closing the dock is remembered across restarts, and the old on/off value is migrated (#3442, #3516, reported by @sjsepan3)
* **Bare `fresh` on a Linux console and with several terminals attached** (#3517, reported by @MAT-services)
  - Faster startup: the first frame no longer waits for plugins to load
  - The session is sized by the terminal last used
  - Console mouse (GPM) works again; selections and indentation guides are visible
  - The dock width scales with the terminal instead of crowding the menu bar
* **Line Numbers, Line Wrap and Current Line Highlight apply to all open documents**, and the View menu reflects the current state (#3449, reported by @sjsepan3)
* **File Explorer** (#3427, reported by @akarinotomoshibi)
  - New File / New Folder create the entry only after the name is confirmed
  - Rename no longer overwrites an existing file
  - Right-click uses the entry under the pointer: empty space selects the project root, and each segment of a `dir1/dir2/dir3` row is selectable
* **Project Search/Replace** - `$1` capture groups are expanded in regex mode, hidden files are searched in current-file scope, and Replace All asks for confirmation in a dialog
* **Selection keys** - Up/Down work when a selection touches the first or last line (#3486, reported by @Korkman); repeated Ctrl+L extends the selection by a line (#3495, reported by @sjsepan3)
* **Plugin timers and crash-recovery saves run in the background session** (#3440, reported by @neatsorg)
* **Restored unnamed buffers use the configured editor settings**, e.g. current line highlight (#3426, reported by @neatsorg)
* **LSP diagnostics are shown on the only line of an empty file** (#3484, reported by @akarinotomoshibi)
* **Mouse release no longer printed at the shell prompt after quitting with a click** (#3474, reported by @odjbo)
* **Update check on Android/Termux no longer panics** (#3453, reported by @dsvarela)
* **Unsaved buffers are kept when switching projects** - they are restored in the project they belong to and no longer multiply across workspace switches and restarts (#3475, #3476, reported by @Korkman; #3530 by @neatsorg)
* **Scroll position is kept when a modifier key is pressed alone** (#3324, reported by @akarinotomoshibi; #3373 by @56steve)
* **Quit is no longer delayed by a background request or a lost mouse release**
* **A second daemon can no longer take over a running session** and leave it unreachable
* **TypeScript 7 (`tsc --lsp`) diagnostics work** (#3061, reported by @defaultkavy; #3413 by @atk)
* **Window title is set in Orchestrator sessions** (#3515 by @neatsorg)
* **Dev container remote indicator is cleared once the container is attached** (#3487 by @cychitivav)
* **Occurrence highlight skips the indentation of a wrapped line** (#3466, reported by @mandolyte)
* **Review mode asks for confirmation before discarding a line selection**
* **Syntax highlighting**
  - Nim: an unpaired apostrophe no longer colors the rest of the file, and `'suffix` number literals are highlighted (#3455, reported by @codic12)
  - JavaScript/TypeScript: a `<` comparison no longer starts JSX highlighting (#3527)
* **Empty pane is dimmed behind Settings** (#3452, reported by @akarinotomoshibi)
* **List selection follows its item** when the list is re-sorted or filtered, and Page Up/Down move by the visible rows
* **Word wrap of long CJK text** no longer drops the end of a line (#3438 by @neatsorg)
* **Review Diff** no longer draws the scrollbar of the hidden file behind it (#3434)
* **Windows GUI build from cmd.exe and PowerShell** - a new `fresh-gui-<target>.zip` ships `fresh-gui.exe` with a `fresh-gui.com` console launcher, so typing `fresh-gui` runs the TUI without the shell competing for keyboard and mouse input (#2965, reported by @mokurin000)

### Internals

* **Plugin API breaking change** - `setPromptSuggestions` throws unless every suggestion has a unique `id` (new, required); `showActionPopup` / `setLspMenuContributions` throw on duplicate ids; widget `List` / `Tree` specs whose `itemKeys` don't match their items one to one are refused
* Flaky e2e test fixes and internal cleanups

name: v0.8.152
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.152

Released on 2026-10-13.

Check and snapshot save each run in its own folder tied to the revision it came from, and renders clean up evidence from old revisions. Project history keeps `.hyperframes/video-state.json` current after every edit and records which element each edit targeted. Agents sharing a project can refuse to start while another agent's turn is open (`--exclusive`), end only their own turn (`--who`), and end safely when no turn is open (`--if-open`).

## Compatibility notes

- Default snapshots moved from `snapshots/` to `.hyperframes/artifacts/snapshots/<id>/`. Check reports are written to `.hyperframes/artifacts/checks/<id>.json`. A render also writes `.hyperframes/render-outputs.json`. Anything still reading `snapshots/` will find nothing. [#5522](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5522)

## Features

- **CLI:** Save check, snapshot and render artifacts per revision ([23d1fe5b4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/23d1fe5b42724a5a9c0458475176d6bddfa235b1), [#5522](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5522)).
- **Studio:** Record video state, edit targets and artifact cleanup in project history ([893b4f675](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/893b4f6757f4d6e8c6a1deb9d2c4743119694b46), [#5524](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5524)).
- **CLI:** Guard history turns with --exclusive, --who and --if-open ([7c73b3cae](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7c73b3caeebc2fd8db2f161f25d4f476ac2f78e2), [#5518](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5518)).

## Fixes

- **Keyframes:** Report unresolved GSAP timing instead of guessing rest poses ([8e4de38be](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8e4de38be1bdf098a7469a98ed654a932351f327), [#5526](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5526)). `keyframes --json` can return null for `start`, `end`, `duration`, and `time` when that timing cannot be resolved.
- **CLI:** Turn off onnxruntime telemetry for Kokoro synthesis ([f25cfbd6b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f25cfbd6bd11d7bb8bd53ea686767c46f8eb146c), [#5425](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5425)).

## Catalog

- **Catalog:** Match preview length to authored compositions ([fb4189ca7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fb4189ca7257411307358b39b6746d42b97f95fd), [#5533](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5533)).

## Internal

- **Inspector:** Publish @hyperframes/inspector to npm ([f31b3c982](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f31b3c982be997897ba989c9975c9b44fe491fda), [#5530](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5530)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.151...v0.8.152

name: v0.8.151
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.151

Released on 2026-10-13.

Standard and high-quality exports preserve graded footage without the colour noise introduced by JPEG frame capture. This release also improves ProRes colours, video cuts and animation seeking.

## Features

- **CLI:** Check warns when a tween ends just after a later tween on the same property ([69f3306415](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/69f33064156a520cdb1c9d63d10bca1c40c75ae2), [#5521](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5521)).
- **Inspector:** Element map, live inspection engine and Node runtime ([072f53cda9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/072f53cda9bb648ef0f4e00836825352e6619d39), [#5509](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5509)).
- **Inspector:** Query timelines and inspect the live preview ([f45788bb6d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f45788bb6d3b4a8d51391b841c815ac6444d2f34), [#5508](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5508)).
- **Inspector:** Add the component inspector package ([73bbd378df](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/73bbd378df6cce37cc8885585018b3055ead8f22), [#5507](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5507)).
- **CLI:** Snapshot a time range or one composition ([1cd086f7e3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1cd086f7e3675c992492714250a09cd36989a5c6), [#5519](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5519)).

## Fixes

- **Producer:** Stop JPEG frame capture adding colour noise to graded footage ([f073281bd9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f073281bd9e81b24d86c646feb863504e4d685f0), [#5514](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5514)).
- **CLI:** Resolve the render worker's tsx loader from the CLI install ([e9216456a5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e9216456a523f0c5e2894ac076dc5950c32aae1a), [#5517](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5517)).
- **Lint:** Read a sub-composition's linked stylesheet from the project root ([9713e93a52](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9713e93a52c4c373a287e10ac977d51298697fc5), [#5084](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5084)).
- **Engine:** Encode and tag ProRes mov output as BT.709 ([c8e105dc92](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c8e105dc9281d29ccd667a72f3cc9f970b1b862f), [#5382](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5382)).
- **Media Use:** Transcript-cut video renders without repeated frames or a keyframe warning ([1d2aa5240d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1d2aa5240d2126ca2763eeffd1bd87c69f2b772d), [#5463](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5463)).
- **CLI:** Say when the Docker image build times out instead of blaming Docker ([3bf9035d2a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3bf9035d2aaee5f90e901576e2d7e548f68cc5f2), [#5394](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5394)).
- **Media Use:** Keep frame precision on transcript-cut seek boundaries ([b71c9f4e1b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b71c9f4e1b3228d51556d910c4836b0803af0251), [#5426](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5426)).
- **Media Use:** Honor telemetryEnabled: false from shared config in optedOut ([1577060dc1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1577060dc182e023d121fddcdffe2589ace1325b), [#5490](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5490)).
- **Studio:** Splitting a video in an untimed wrapper cuts the video, not the wrapper ([aa9413b05e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/aa9413b05ebba83eb1c96f3ebdb707ba51cf1897), [#5486](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5486)).
- **Core:** An animation playing at its first seek shows the sought time ([5e6e58fc9b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5e6e58fc9baee3cc1b7b3cda937280b7be573b6e), [#5503](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5503)).
- **Media:** Read ElevenLabs input as UTF-8 ([ea7a4e433f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ea7a4e433f8c646825cfb25ef468461bc5047814), [#5469](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5469)).
- **Media Use:** Clean up temporary TTS text directories ([73d89b81c7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/73d89b81c7617c22fcfcb2e5d182faa8b9410776), [#5477](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5477)).
- **Skills:** Reject occlusion timeout before verdict ([4120042ca3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4120042ca3b8e4c6e09ab9b76ce988d56837687b), [#5491](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5491)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Lint:** Add a reference page for every lint finding code ([c3816a121b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c3816a121b0dae08af2e3bf13df9d2fe225628bf), [#5493](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5493)).
- **CLI:** Document open, catch-up, timeline and history ([2973b3c8e4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2973b3c8e4464a2cd454d0909dd59c4277afd6f3), [#5442](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5442)).
- **Changelog:** Weekly digest 2026-10-05–2026-10-12 ([86ff462d21](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/86ff462d21b5f72b52cb2762dee60491b58dc531), [#5497](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5497)).
- **Changelog:** Weekly digest 2026-09-28-2026-10-05 ([0e535ac6ab](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0e535ac6abb1a92a93260f88157bfd77961bf678), [#5076](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5076)).

## Catalog

- **Catalog:** Publish generated catalog ([ab06445439](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ab06445439333ce23eb5e415f9c51e3bd3ac461d), [#5500](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5500)).

body:
Mostly fixes for the level you pick. It now survives context compaction instead of falling back to the default, and on macOS the hooks can no longer lose their output, so the ruleset always arrives.

name: v5.1.1
body:
A fix release. The big one is the codebase map from 5.0: a repo could slip its own text into the hidden session context, and a symlink in the repo could hang the session start until the ruleset never arrived. Both are fixed, and the map now has a one-second limit, so the rules always load.

name: v3.4.0
body:
## psmux v3.4.0

Terminal multiplexer for Windows - tmux alternative for PowerShell and Windows Terminal.

### Highlights

* **Signed binaries.** Every `psmux.exe`, `pmux.exe` and `tmux.exe`, every installer and the uninstaller inside it are now code signed (Certum, "Open Source Developer Godwin Josh") with a timestamp, so Windows no longer shows them as coming from an unknown publisher.
* **Floating panes** with `prefix *` (`new-pane`), listed by `list-panes`, with their own cursor and a confirmation on `prefix x`.
* **Synchronized output (DECSET 2026).** Claude Code and other TUIs that draw a frame at a time no longer flicker or show half drawn frames.
* **The command prompt edits like tmux's.** One shared editor for every prompt: `C-b`, `C-f`, `C-h`, `C-d`, `C-u`, `C-k`, `C-w`, `C-t`, history on `C-p` and `C-n`, and keys the prompt has no use for no longer leak into the pane behind it.
* **Command lists from the CLI** run every command in order (`psmux new-session -d \; split-window \; ...`), including inside `if-shell` branches, and a trailing `;` ends a command the way tmux reads it.
* **Choosers closer to tmux:** `x` asks before it kills, `q` and `C-g` close every chooser, `+` `-` `h` `l` expand and collapse the tree, Page Up and Page Down move by the list height, and another session's windows expand to their panes.
* **tmux parity** for `show-environment` / `set-environment` and `update-environment`, `set-clipboard`, `key-table`, `select-pane -d` / `-e`, case exact session names, and `if-shell` / `run-shell` format expansion.
* **Terminals:** Alacritty on Windows now gets the VT input route (the prefix works and nothing is typed into the pane at startup), plus fixes for pastes, Escape Escape and mouse handling across Windows Terminal, WezTerm and conhost.
* **Faster and steadier:** a warm pool three panes deep for instant splits and windows, sturdier server teardown, and no stranded shells after `kill-server`.

### Special thanks

This release is as much yours as mine. Thank you all for the code, the measurements and the patience:

* **@tanaeakihiko** for an extraordinary run of work: the shared prompt editor and `C-t` (#784, #786), the Alacritty input fix (#788), `set-clipboard` parity (#772), the chooser kill confirmation (#779), copy mode page scrolling, keyboard selection and goto line (#682, #688, #723), cursor shape restore (#736), prompt cursor and paste routing fixes (#743, #745, #747, #751), the floating pane follow ups (#770) and many more, plus the key by key tmux audits of copy mode, the choosers and the prompts (#694, #776, #782) that drove a large part of this release.
* **@tscodeplus** for `window-size latest` that follows the active client (#663), `mouse-drag-enter-copy-mode` (#664), a copy mode that works on a snapshot while `capture-pane` stays live (#671), copy mode yank and resize fixes (#665, #666, #678), CJK and burst paste fixes (#667, #676, #701), reconnect and reader robustness (#710, #737) and a non blocking foreground `run-shell` (#740).
* **@MattKotsenas** for configurable active pane border indicators (#628), centralized render options (#633), OSC 8 hyperlinks in `client_termfeatures` (#764), `split-window -Z` (#572), deferred command targets (#587), window style and border background fixes (#617, #624), and Clippy in CI for the pty crate (#591, #595).
* **@darkmirage** for `select-pane -d` / `-e` (#777) and CLI command lists that run every command in one connection (#780).
* **@maxmya** for synchronized output support that ends the flicker next to Claude Code (#781).
* **@Adamkadaban** for opt in drag to copy inside mouse aware applications (#575).
* **@neich** for drag selections that auto scroll through scrollback at the pane edges (#590).
* **@PhotoAtomic** for making the wheel scroll over inline TUIs instead of cycling their prompt history (#548).
* **@BizaNator** for the base64 `send-paste` CLI transport (#584).
* **@airHalfSoundHalf** for parking a hidden pane cursor so IME composition follows the caret (#727).
* **@cloudor126** for giving nushell its own dialect when panes are rehomed (#721).
* **@c3nx** for keeping the server detached after a console injection (#762).
* **@andrew-tawfeek** for refreshing build provenance after source edits and worktree changes (#636).
* **@457shop** for the wheel authorization idea in #614, which shaped the fix that landed for #613.

And thank you to everyone who opened issues with careful reproductions and stayed to retest. Every one of them made psmux better.

### Changelog (v3.3.8 to v3.4.0)

- Release 3.4.0: bump version, release notes with highlights and contributor thanks above the generated changelog (20aa1d72)
- installer: 32 MB LZMA dictionary so the three binaries share one copy (x64 setup 6.8 MB to 2.6 MB, measured on the signing rehearsal's signed binaries) (8eda694a)

- test(disc 776): chooser parity suite (cursor under the choosers, paging by list height, q and C-g, + - h l in the tree, C-n C-p, another session's rows, in process choose-client and list-clients) (2812de73)

### Downloads

**Portable (zip):**
| Platform | File |
|----------|------|
| Windows x64 (Intel/AMD 64-bit) | `psmux-v3.4.0-windows-x64.zip` |
| Windows x86 (Intel/AMD 32-bit) | `psmux-v3.4.0-windows-x86.zip` |
| Windows ARM64 (Snapdragon/Surface Pro X) | `psmux-v3.4.0-windows-arm64.zip` |

**Installer (NSIS setup: kills running instances, adds to PATH, warmup):**
| Platform | File |
|----------|------|
| Windows x64 | `psmux-v3.4.0-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows x86 | `psmux-v3.4.0-x86-setup.exe` |
| Windows ARM64 | `psmux-v3.4.0-arm64-setup.exe` |

### Installation

**Via Scoop (recommended):**
```powershell
scoop bucket add psmux https://github.com/psmux/scoop-psmux
scoop install psmux
```

**Via Chocolatey:**
```powershell
choco install psmux
```

**Via WinGet:**
```powershell
winget install marlocarlo.psmux
```

**Via Cargo:**
```powershell
cargo install psmux
```

**Via PowerShell:**
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/psmux/psmux/master/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Manual Installation:**
1. Download the zip matching your architecture
2. Extract to a folder in your PATH
3. `psmux`, `pmux`, and `tmux` commands will all be available

### What's Included
- `psmux.exe` - Main executable
- `pmux.exe` - Alias
- `tmux.exe` - Alias for tmux compatibility

## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Breaking Changes

- Removed `estimateImageContentTokens()` from `@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core/image-tokens`; use `Tokenizer.imageTokens(size, detail)`, which prices with the reading model's catalog image rule ([#15446](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15446) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- `applyShakeRegion()` and `applyShakeRegions()` take the replacement's token count (`replacementTokens`); a block rewrite of an assistant turn adds the tokens it removes to `elidedOutputTokens`, so a replayed Claude turn's count stays lowered after a reload ([#15446](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15446) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- Fixed Claude context counts reading Opus 5.5 requests about 55% over their billed input: a replayed thinking turn now counts at the output size Claude billed for it, not its signature's bytes ([#15446](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15446) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed screenshots and other non-frame images being counted at the OpenAI rate for every model instead of the reading model's own; Claude billed them about 16% higher ([#15446](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15446) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed OpenAI Responses and Codex context estimates leaving out replayed reasoning: each turn whose encrypted reasoning actually replays now counts its reported reasoning tokens (its ciphertext when the backend reports none), and none while a cold session rebuilds it out of the request, so compaction and snapcompact sizing match billing; branch summaries no longer budget for encrypted reasoning they never send ([#15447](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15447) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Breaking Changes

- `isOfficialCodexApiUrl` moved from `@oh-my-pi/pi-ai` to `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog/wire/codex`, next to `CODEX_BASE_URL`, so the catalog's compat resolver classifies Codex endpoints with the same check ([#15434](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15434) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Added

- Added `withoutUnverifiedThinking` utility to filter reasoning capability from models when no effort is requested
- Added `reachesOfficialEndpoint(model)`: whether a request to the model reaches the official endpoint its compat was built for, following `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and Foundry's `FOUNDRY_BASE_URL` reroutes of first-party Anthropic models ([#15434](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15434) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added `AssistantMessage.elidedOutputTokens`, the visible output tokens a history rewrite (shake) has removed from the turn, which `usage.output` still counts ([#15446](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15446) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Exported `shouldDropTruncatedThinkingOnlyAssistant` from `providers/transform-messages`, `isColdReplayableResponsesTurn` from `providers/openai-shared` and the new `openAIResponsesReplaysNativeHistory` from `providers/openai-responses`, so local token estimates can follow which turns replay drops and whether a session replays native history ([#15447](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15447) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- Fixed Claude on Google Antigravity failing every turn with "image exceeds 5 MB maximum" once a large image entered the conversation; images are now downscaled to the host's limits before sending, as on the Anthropic API ([#15444](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15444) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Breaking Changes

- `resolveInlineImageByteBudget(model, officialEndpoint)` and `resolveImageCountBudget(model, officialEndpoint)` take whether the request reaches the official endpoint instead of reading `compat.officialEndpoint`, which misses request-time reroutes such as `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`; pass pi-ai's `reachesOfficialEndpoint(model)` ([#15434](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15434) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Added

- Added Muse Wonder (`muse-wonder-1.0`) to Meta and Muse Code with its `minimal`–`max` effort ladder and pricing
- Added the `thinking-unverified` rule axis: on hosts whose model list carries no capability metadata (Meta, Muse Code), unrecognized models now offer an opt-in thinking ladder (`ThinkingConfig.unverified`) instead of none
- Added `thinking-unverified` axis for offering reasoning ladders on unclassified model IDs
- Added `Muse Wonder 1.0` model definition to Meta provider
- Added the opt-in `snapcompact-image-reads` axis: snapcompact images a fresh `read` result only for readers whose rule sets it; Claude Opus 5.5 and later opt in ([#14249](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14249) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added the `image-count-budget` rule for how many images one request may carry (Anthropic 90, Codex 200, other hosts unchanged) and the `official-image-count-budget` override that applies only on the official endpoint: Anthropic 600 (100 on 200k-window Claude models), Codex 2,000 ([#15434](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15434) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added a 24 MB inline-image byte budget for the Codex backend, which now counts as its official endpoint at its default URL and at paths under it such as `/codex/responses` ([#15434](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15434) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added `isOfficialCodexApiUrl` to `wire/codex`, moved from pi-ai ([#15434](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15434) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added `verified` to `image-tokenization` rules, marking the Claude 4.7+ high-res tier and the GPT-5.5 to 6.1 and gpt-6-astra rules as matching measured provider billing ([#15442](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15442) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added the `image-max-edge` axis and `resolveImageMaxEdge()` for hosts that shrink images before the model reads them; Cursor's Claude and GPT models and its `default` (Auto) route fit 1024×1024 ([#15448](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15448) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added the `thinking-replay-tokens` axis; Claude lines set it to `output` on every host, since a replayed signed thinking block bills the turn's full reasoning, not the signature's bytes ([#15446](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15446) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added a KDL opt-in for sibling subagent prompt-cache sharing, enabled for Muse Code's Spark 1.3, Wonder 1.0, and Wonder Full 1.0 variants over the Responses API ([#15467](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15467) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal))

### Changed

- Updated model definitions and compatibility rules for provider metadata
- Google Antigravity, xAI and Cursor requests keep up to 60 images, 20 for Claude on Antigravity and Cursor, up from 5; this counts snapcompact frames and live screenshots together ([#15449](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15449) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Snapcompact sizes archives at the frame prices measured for Antigravity Gemini (a fixed 1,089 tokens), Grok 4.6 to 4.20, and Claude Sonnet 4.6's standard tier ([#15449](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15449) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- Applied `max-image-dimension` and `max-image-payload-bytes` to Google API models, and declared the 5 MiB per-image limit of Claude on Google Antigravity ([#15444](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15444) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed local token counts for OpenAI GPT-5 and later models (Codex, OpenAI, Azure, OpenRouter, Copilot and other hosts) reading about 12% low: their text is now counted with o200k_base instead of a bytes/4 estimate ([#15447](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15447) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added `task.agentSoftRequestBudget` to give named subagents their own soft request budget, so a long-running agent can get more requests (or `0` for no guard) while scout, sonic and other agents keep theirs ([#15419](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15419) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added `o200k` as a `tokenizer` value for custom models and overrides in `models.yml` ([#15447](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15447) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Changed

- Sized snapcompact archives for Claude 4.7+ and GPT-5.5 to 6.1 (gpt-6-astra included) at each frame's measured price instead of at least 5,024 tokens, so Codex archives can hold up to 1.7× as many frames when the room under the compaction trigger is the limit ([#15442](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15442) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Enabled sibling subagent prompt-cache sharing for Muse Code's Spark 1.3, Wonder 1.0, and Wonder Full 1.0 variants while keeping their conversations separate ([#15467](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15467) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal), based on [#15285](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15285) by [@YueyuHoshizora](https://github.com/YueyuHoshizora))
- Reduced tool-result tokens by omitting subsecond bash timing and redundant task size metadata ([#15468](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15468) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal); [#15265](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15265); based on [#15284](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15284) by [@YueyuHoshizora](https://github.com/YueyuHoshizora))
- On the official Anthropic and Codex endpoints, snapcompact archives may carry up to 12 MB of frames instead of 3 MB, Anthropic requests keep up to 600 images (100 on 200k-window models) instead of 90, and Codex requests up to 2,000 instead of 200; custom base URLs, including Anthropic requests rerouted by `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` or Foundry's `FOUNDRY_BASE_URL`, keep the previous limits and no longer get Anthropic's 24 MB inline image byte limit ([#15434](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15434) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- Fixed `snapcompact.toolResults` re-sending each large tool result as images a turn after it went out as text, which broke the prompt cache and Anthropic signed thinking every turn; results are now imaged from their first send, and `read` results stay text unless the model is known to edit exactly from images (Opus 5.5+) ([#14249](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14249) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed compaction on Claude sessions with thinking sometimes keeping about half the recent history `compaction.keepRecentTokens` asks for, because each kept turn was counted at its signature's size ([#15446](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15446) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed retry fallback rejecting a model with a smaller window by charging it the reasoning the active model's provider usage replayed, and the output cap charging reasoning a cold Responses session leaves out of its first request ([#15447](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15447) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed anonymized session exports losing whether bash timing was shown ([#15468](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15468) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal))
- Added `omp --restore <session>`: resumes a session like `--resume`, then goes on with what its last process left unfinished when it crashed or was killed, both the interrupted turn and the subagents it was running (their results reach the parent as usual); Tern's session daemon now restarts omp with it after a crash
- Kept private prompt-cache routing keys out of shared sessions and HTML exports ([#15467](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15467) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal))

## @oh-my-pi/snapcompact

### Breaking Changes

- `providerImageBudget(provider)` and `providerFrameBudget(provider)` became `providerImageBudget(model)` and `providerFrameBudget(model)`, and `maxFramesForDataBudget(shape)` became `maxFramesForDataBudget(shape, budget)` with a required byte budget ([#15434](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15434) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Removed `PROVIDER_IMAGE_BUDGETS` and `FRAME_DATA_BYTES_BUDGET`: image counts come from the catalog's `image-count-budget` rules, and frame byte budgets from `frameDataBytesBudget(model)` (`DEFAULT_FRAME_DATA_BYTES_BUDGET` where the host has none) ([#15434](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15434) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Added

- Added `plannedFrameTokens` and `Shape.frameTokensVerified`: archive sizing charges a frame its own price when the reader's `image-tokenization` rule is `verified`, and at least `FRAME_TOKEN_ESTIMATE` otherwise ([#15442](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15442) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- Fixed snapcompact frames for Claude and GPT on Cursor, including its `default` (Auto) route, being drawn at 1568–1932px, which Cursor shrank to 1024px before the model read them; frames now render at the host's catalog `image-max-edge` ([#15448](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15448) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Changed

- Updated model picker to offer manual effort selection for unverified models instead of automatic mode

### Fixed

- Fixed the `snapcompact.shape` settings preview labelling variants `5x8-sent` and repeating the first variant's sample when the frame edge differs from the variant table (Claude and GPT on Cursor; `auto` on high-resolution Claude) ([#15448](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15448) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))


## What's Changed
* feat(task): let named subagents get their own soft request budget by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15419
* feat(catalog,snapcompact,coding-agent): size snapcompact request limits from catalog policy by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15434
* fix(catalog,snapcompact,coding-agent): size snapcompact archives at billing-verified frame prices by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15442
* fix(ai,catalog): clamp Claude images to Antigravity's 5 MiB limit by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15444
* fix(catalog,snapcompact,tui): keep snapcompact frames legible to Claude and GPT on Cursor by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15448
* feat(catalog): size snapcompact archives on Antigravity, xAI and Cursor from measured limits and prices by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15449
* fix(agent,catalog,coding-agent): count replayed Claude thinking and images at what Claude bills by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15446
* perf(tools): trim bash timing and task size metadata by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15468
* fix(catalog,agent,ai,coding-agent): count GPT-5 and later context the way OpenAI bills it by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15447
* fix(coding-agent): stop snapcompact tool-result imaging from rewriting already-sent results by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14249
* perf(task): share sibling prompt-cache keys on opted-in providers by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15467


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/compare/v18.10.2...v18.10.3

name: v1.2.0
body:
### New Features

- **Per-key OpenRouter model lists**: with an OpenRouter key, Pi lists only the models that key may use, with the key's context size, max output, and prices, including regional endpoints set in `models.json`. See [OpenRouter](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/providers.md#openrouter).
- **Published configuration schemas**: add `$schema` to `settings.json`, `models.json`, keybindings, and themes for editor validation and completion. See [Settings](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/settings.md), [Models](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/models.md), [Keybindings](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/keybindings.md), and [Themes](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/themes.md).
- **Clipboard copies over remote sessions**: `PI_CLIPBOARD_OSC52=1` sends copied text to a remote client's clipboard when Pi cannot detect the remote session, such as a multiplexer attached from another machine. See [Pi Process Configuration](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/environment-variables.md#pi-process-configuration).
- **Codemode improvements**: tool declarations show input constraints such as integer, minimum/maximum, and default, and codemode rows show elapsed and total time. See [Codemode](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/codemode.md).
- **`before_agent_start` for extension-triggered runs**: runs started by `pi.sendMessage(..., { triggerTurn: true })` go through the same setup as prompts. See [Events and concurrency](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/extensions.md#events-and-concurrency).

### Breaking Changes

- Published generated configuration schemas for models, settings, keybindings, and themes at `https://pi.dev/schemas/*.schema.json`. The theme schema moved to `https://pi.dev/schemas/theme.schema.json`; themes loaded during startup now receive the same schema validation as later reloads. Update theme `$schema` references, define reusable colors under `vars`, and remove unsupported metadata ([#9880](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9880), [#10751](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10751) by [@christianklotz](https://github.com/christianklotz))
- Changed `before_agent_start` to also fire for runs started by `pi.sendMessage(..., { triggerTurn: true })` while idle. `BeforeAgentStartEvent` is now a union on `messageType`: `"user"` events carry `prompt` and `images`, and `"custom"` events carry the starting `message` and no `prompt`. Messages returned by handlers are added to both kinds of run, and pending `deliverAs: "nextTurn"` messages are delivered with the custom-message run. Handlers that should act only on user prompts must check `event.messageType === "user"` ([#10267](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10267), [#5581](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5581), [#10739](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10739) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai))
- Changed the session to count as busy while a run starts, including during `before_agent_start` handlers: `ctx.isIdle()` is false, `pi.sendMessage()` queues into the starting run instead of starting a second run that failed with "Agent is already processing", `pi.sendUserMessage()` requires `deliverAs`, and an abort requested meanwhile aborts the run once it starts ([#10739](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10739) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai))
- Changed `pi mcp list --json` to report `resources: true` for servers that offer resources instead of `resources` and `resourceTemplates` counts; Pi no longer lists resources when connecting ([#10526](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10526))

### Added

- Added `reachesTools` to tool definitions, so tools that reach other tools (such as `codemode` and `tool_search`) declare which tools a call may reach; the MCP extension uses it to wait for the servers a call needs and to decide whether a replacement `codemode` or `tool_search` tool can reach MCP tools
- Added `aliases` to tool namespaces; codemode's `describeNamespace()` and the `namespace` option of `searchTools()` match them, and MCP namespaces use the server name
- Added per-key OpenRouter model lists: with an OpenRouter key, Pi lists only the chat models that key may use, with the key's context size, max output, and prices, including guardrails and regional endpoints set as the base URL in `models.json`. The list is saved and used offline ([#10353](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10353), [#10672](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10672) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai))
- Added `PI_CLIPBOARD_OSC52=1` to send copied text to the terminal with OSC 52 after the local clipboard write, so copies reach a remote client's clipboard when Pi cannot detect the remote session, such as multiplexer attaches from another machine or remote IDE daemons ([#10826](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10826), [#10835](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10835), [#10114](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10114))
- Added elapsed time while a codemode script runs and its total time once finished to the codemode tool row, like bash rows ([#10708](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10708))

### Changed

- Changed the `showHardwareCursor` setting to use only the terminal cursor instead of also drawing Pi's reverse-video cursor
- Changed codemode tool declarations to show input constraints such as integer, minimum/maximum, length, pattern, and default as `@` tags on property comments, so scripts see them without the tool repeating them in descriptions ([#10707](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10707))
- Changed codemode declarations of MCP tools to spell out the result type (`content`, `structuredContent`, `isError`) instead of referring to `CallToolResult<T>`, which `describeTool()`, `searchTools()`, and `ALL_TOOLS` showed without defining it; the codemode description no longer includes the shared MCP types
- Changed `serializeConversation()` (compaction, branch summaries, bug reports) to omit thinking blocks; replayed thinking is often not in the live context, so including it could make a summarization request larger than the context it summarizes and fail

### Fixed

- Fixed codemode ignoring a `// @options:` line that is not the first line of the script, which ran the script without the requested `timeout_ms`; the call now fails with an error before the script runs ([#10631](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10631))
- Fixed Mistral streams being aborted mid-generation (e.g. during long thinking) after the request timeout; the timeout now applies only to waiting for response headers ([#10609](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10609))
- Fixed a symlinked `AGENTS.md` in a git worktree nested inside its main repo causing no project context file to load ([#10681](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10681))
- Fixed the code mode tool description claiming every failed tool call rejects; a tool that declares an output schema resolves with its value on failure too (e.g. `bash` with a nonzero exit)
- Fixed runs started by `pi.sendMessage(..., { triggerTurn: true })` removing system prompt sections added in `before_agent_start` after their first tool call, which changed the prompt mid-run and broke the provider prompt cache twice per run ([#10267](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10267), [#10739](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10739) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai))
- Fixed codemode blocking the process for seconds to minutes after scripts with many `text()` calls; joining the output items was quadratic ([#10678](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10678))
- Fixed print mode (`-p`) exiting 0 without a warning when the final response was cut off at the model's output token limit; it now prints the partial text, writes a warning to stderr, and exits 1 ([#10799](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10799))
- Fixed `pi mcp login --help` and the CLI docs describing `--timeout` as only the wait for the browser; it limits the whole sign-in ([#10636](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10636))
- Fixed `~` not being expanded in `!pattern`, `+path`, and `-path` entries of the `extensions`, `skills`, `prompts`, and `themes` settings, so entries like `!~/skills/pdf` matched nothing ([#10765](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10765))
- Fixed MCP servers with resources registering no tools until every resource was listed; Pi no longer lists resources when connecting, so `/mcp` and `pi mcp list` show that a server offers resources instead of counting them ([#10526](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10526))
- Fixed MCP tool calls failing when the server returns structured content that is not an object (an array, `null`, or a primitive, as MCP 2026-07-28 allows); codemode declarations of MCP tools without an output schema now type `structuredContent` as `unknown` instead of an object ([#10416](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10416))
- Fixed reading or writing `auth.json` on Windows failing with `EPERM` when the previous lock folder was still being deleted; Pi now retries briefly before reporting the error ([#10801](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10801))
- Fixed OpenRouter router models such as `openrouter/auto` showing a cost of -$1,000,000 per 1M tokens; OpenRouter's negative placeholder prices are now 0 ([#10672](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10672) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai))
- Fixed Anthropic requests failing when the provider rejects the strict tool set for grammar size, tool count, or union limits; Pi now retries once with preferred tools non-strict ([#10409](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10409))
- Fixed "The upstream provider returned an error" not being retried as a transient provider error ([#10842](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10842))
- Fixed focused fullscreen overlays blocking mouse-wheel scrolling of the transcript ([#10769](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10769))
- Fixed fragmented terminal color replies leaking hex values into the prompt and opening the external editor (related reports: [#10256](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10256), [#10657](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10657))
- Fixed inline images not rendering in Herdr since 1.1.0 ([#10774](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10774) by [@ogulcancelik](https://github.com/ogulcancelik))
- Fixed key bindings that name a shifted symbol, such as `+` or `ctrl++`, not matching under the Kitty keyboard protocol or modifyOtherKeys ([#9880](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9880) by [@christianklotz](https://github.com/christianklotz))
- Fixed the compaction status indicator embedded in a custom editor using the default muted colors instead of the editor border or thinking-level color, as the working indicator does ([#10809](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10809), [#10810](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10810) by [@Jay-Madden](https://github.com/Jay-Madden))
- Fixed MCP tool calls that were cancelled or timed out while waiting for an OAuth refresh still being sent to the server once the refresh finished ([#10598](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10598))
- Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in accepting an authorization response with an `iss` parameter that could not be checked because no authorization server metadata was discovered; sign-in now fails with an issuer mismatch. Reported by [@AizenvoltPrime](https://github.com/AizenvoltPrime)
- Fixed codemode failing with a broken bridge error when Pi runs under `node --watch` on Node 24 or 26 ([#10725](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10725))

### Removed

- Removed the unreleased experimental server, client, and plugin stack (`src/experimental`, `src/cli/experimental`) and its source-only `./client` and `./experimental/plugin` exports; none of it was part of the published package. The `@earendil-works/pi-client`, `@earendil-works/pi-protocol`, and `@earendil-works/pi-server` packages it used are removed and no longer released
- Removed the dependency on `@earendil-works/chord`

name: Reasonix Studio v2.38.0
body:
本版加入从任意回复分支会话、会话批量操作、模型显示别名和 MCP 工具定义变更审批，并修复长对话里拖选文字卡死、重载后丢失撤销入口等问题。

## 新增

- 可以从任意一条回复分支出一个独立的新会话 (#12770)

- 对话导航旁显示当前计划 (#12803)
- 浏览器面板新增宽屏模式，打开时仍能看到对话；浏览器页面可以逐个或批量关闭 (#11762, #12806)
- 文件面板右键增加「复制路径」和「复制引用」，名称里含冒号或以反斜杠结尾而无法表示成引用时会禁用后者 (#12818, #12842 by @XTLine)
- 可以给每个模型设置显示别名；添加来源前可以批量检测模型 (#12821, #12835)
- 模型偏好里可以设置联网搜索使用的模型 (#11761)
- MCP 服务器的工具定义变更后，需要重新批准才会启用 (#12829)
- 回退之后对话顶部显示持久的撤销提示，可以关闭，重载后仍在 (#12831, #12559 by @XTLine)
- 可以在右键菜单里引用选中的回复文字 (#12836)
- 发送快捷键成为统一的偏好设置 (#12837)
- 反馈表单里可以直接打开日志文件夹；反馈对话折叠显示并保留未读状态 (#12768, #12802)

- 工作台「+」按钮会显示启动器，从导航打开聚焦会话的文件 (#12826 by @XTLine, #12832)

## 变更

- 会话标签页改为按需开启 (#12841)

- 对话壁纸下的文字光晕可以配置 (#12839)
- 当前使用的模型在输入框的选择器里排第一 (#12801)
- 手机窄屏上未输入时的输入框更紧凑，并保留分支标识 (#12800, #12813)
- 左侧图标栏的图标与对应设置分区一致；设置页打开时侧边栏开关仍可用 (#12753, #12798)
- 首屏改用 1.9 MB 的核心字体子集；对话导航条每个可区分位置只画一个标记 (#12766, #12767)
- 多个会话共用一个工作区时，写入改用乐观租约 (#12772)
- 没有声明检查的项目里，写过文件的未识别命令不再免除验证 (#12848 by @boscocp)

- 密集的时间线信号可以逐个查看 (#12815)

body:
### Minor Changes

- 2d57b23: Add a `foreign` mode to the OAuth audience check on the hosted HTTP transport. `MCP_OAUTH_AUDIENCE_ENFORCEMENT=foreign` answers HTTP 401 (`WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token"`, "This token was issued for another server. If you connect through a gateway or proxy, use a Context7 API key instead.") to a Clerk OAuth JWT whose `aud` names another server, and still admits a token with no `aud`, which grants authorized before Clerk's "Include Audience" setting carry on every refresh. `observe` (the default) and `required` are unchanged. The query string of an audience on an allowed host is ignored, since Cursor writes the configured MCP URL (`https://mcp.context7.com/mcp?client=codex`) into `resource`; on any other host it is kept. The `audienceMismatch` log line now carries `outcome=accepted|rejected` and is written at most once per token per hour instead of every ten minutes.

### Patch Changes

- 2882596: Verify Microsoft Entra token signatures before looking up the audience, and cap the Entra config cache.

name: v0.8.5
body:
## [0.8.5] - 2026-10-12

### Added

- **Python 3.15 support (#2480).** Add Python 3.15 classifier, documentation,
  and testing across CI matrices.

### Fixed

- **Expired cold-start authentication (#2461, #2464).** Exhausted login-redirect
  recovery raises `AuthError`, so Python callers can catch it, CLI commands
  return `AUTH_ERROR` with exit 1, and MCP tools preserve the re-login hint.
  Read-only Android auth loading reports the same error without running Web
  recovery or persisting cookies.

- **Signed-out sessions misreported as a page-structure change (#2479, #2481).**
  The app host now answers a signed-out request with a token-less landing page
  instead of a sign-in redirect. When the CSRF token is missing, token loading
  now asks the app's `/login` endpoint whether the session is signed in. A
  stale session reports `Authentication expired` and enters the existing login
  recovery, instead of `CSRF token not found ... page structure has changed`.

- **Headless and CDP re-auth no longer capture a signed-out browser session
  (#2482, #2483).** An app-host landing with a `SID` cookie is no longer enough: the
  capture first asks the app's `/login`, through the browser context's own
  cookies, whether the session is signed in. A signed-out session is refused
  with `HeadlessLoginRequiredError` and the saved authentication is kept,
  instead of being overwritten with another expired set. If the check cannot
  be answered, capture proceeds as before.

- **Browser session capture validation and auth doctor (#2472).** Validate
  captured browser storage cookies across SPA navigation, refuse anonymous
  captures, and clarify diagnostic warnings in `notebooklm doctor`.

- **Tokenless Web auth recovery and generation journal (#2465).** Recover
  tokenless Web authentication and journal generation at submission time.

- **Release archives packaging (#2463).** Exclude internal repository assets
  from release distribution archives.

- **CI resilience and recovery (#2458, #2460, #2462, #2473, #2475).** Install
  impersonate extra for package verification, recover tagged publishes with
  release-scoped auth allowances, allow scheduler delays in upload and
  download fault scenarios, and reconcile auth repository lint guardrails.

- **MCP test isolation (#2459).** Isolate MCP backend flag tests from ambient
  user profiles.

### Changed

- **FastMCP 4.1.0 and MCP 2.x upgrade (#2480).** Bump FastMCP to 4.1.0 and adapt
  MCP tool annotations and tool result handling for Python 3.15 compatibility.
- **Android protobuf toolchain upgrade (#2480).** Upgrade pinned toolchain to
  grpcio 1.84.0 and protobuf 7.36.2 for Python 3.15 wheel support.
- **Dependency updates.** Bump pyjwt to 2.15.0 (#2456), beartype to 0.23.1 (#2480),
  and librt (#2480).

name: v0.21.11
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.21.11

`0.21.11` is a patch release for the frozen range `v0.21.10..7e0b5f2330b9d85c5fdb9709ec0104e099836f4c` (3 commits, 2 files, +68/−5): native agent TOMLs no longer retain stale inherited model providers.

## Highlights

- **Fresh provider inheritance (#3781, fixes #3779):** native agent TOMLs omit `model_provider` when it only mirrors the root `config.toml` default, so changing the provider no longer leaves stale agent configuration or requires `omx setup --force`. Explicit per-agent model overrides remain supported.

## Fixes and compatibility

- Avoid baking inherited root `model_provider` values into native agent TOMLs; preserve explicit per-agent overrides (#3781, fixes #3779).
- Patch release with no intentional breaking CLI or package-layout changes.

## Validation evidence

Frozen candidate green on dev CI; local build, typecheck, and relevant tests recorded.

Full readiness evidence: `docs/qa/release-readiness-0.21.11.md`.

## Merged PR inventory

| PR | Author | Title |
|---|---|---|
| [#3781](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex/pull/3781) | @Yeachan-Heo | fix: do not bake model_provider into agent TOMLs for default inheritance (fixes #3779) |

## Contributors

Thanks to [@clawdbot](https://github.com/clawdbot) and [@Yeachan-Heo](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo) for contributing to this release.

## Inventory

# oh-my-codex v0.21.10

`0.21.10` is a patch release for the frozen range `v0.21.9..72fee0236cf8a4b45e6dd9b3d826871f402b84ae` (16 commits, 15 files, +1067/−82): astra-defaults evaluation infrastructure hardening, configuration merge robustness, and npm registry-visibility diagnostics.

## Highlights

- **TOML configuration merge robustness (#3777, fixes #3776):** multi-line arrays in the `[tui]` configuration section are now correctly preserved during config merge operations, preventing loss of array elements and enabling complex TUI customization without manual repair.
- **Astra-defaults evaluation infrastructure (#3655, #3765, #3772):** the astra-defaults RunRecord collector gains base URL support for flexible test fixture hosting and implements repository cloning with fixture context, enabling live cost and quality evaluation across model configurations. Collector is now hermetic with bounded Codex v0.162+ JSON-line parsing and includes CI integration (#3768).
- **npm registry-visibility diagnostics (#3771):** registry-visibility checks now include extended timeout windows and improved diagnostics to surface transient publication issues earlier and support troubleshooting of npm registry visibility failures in CI pipelines.

## Fixes and compatibility

- Fix preservation of multi-line arrays in TOML `[tui]` configuration sections during merge operations (#3777, fixes #3776).
- Harden astra-defaults collector for hermetic operation with correct handling of Codex v0.162+ JSON-line output format and repository cloning (#3772, #3774).
- Extend npm registry-visibility check window and improve diagnostics for faster visibility confirmation (#3771).
- Patch release with no intentional breaking CLI or package-layout changes.

## Validation evidence

Frozen candidate green on dev CI; local build, typecheck, and full compiled test suite recorded.

Full readiness evidence: `docs/qa/release-readiness-0.21.10.md`.

## Contributors

Thanks to [@clawdbot](https://github.com/clawdbot) and [@Yeachan-Heo](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo) for contributing to this release.

## Inventory

name: openclaw 2026.10.5-beta.3
body:
## 2026.10.5-beta.3

### Highlights

- **Updates leave the Gateway running:** pnpm 12 installs keep their Gateway service and `openclaw` launcher on the durable install path, Windows updates accept qualified Scheduled Task accounts and their own verified driver, macOS accepts protected Bun service commands, and clean service-install refusals no longer leave the Gateway stopped. (#170003, #169059, #170131, #169244, #169481, #169563, #170006, #169662, #169658, #169915) Thanks @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @RomneyDa, @jokerman1302-eng, and @vincentkoc.
- **Stuck updates recover:** updates settle package-activation journals after filesystem remounts or device-number drift, ride out a briefly locked state database, stop reporting false post-install failures after migration, and reclaim retained updater runtimes that blocked npm recovery. (#169410, #170046, #169050, #169352, #168210, #170130, #169422, #170170, #169463) Thanks @patrickschiller, @RomneyDa, @SergeiAug, @angeliti999, and @Warhangel.
- **Doctor keeps credentials and data:** Doctor no longer deletes an OAuth profile when the legacy auth store is unreadable, refuses retired state before migrating the database, imports retained ACP metadata, and restores a stopped Gateway when cleanup fails. (#170256, #168959, #170051, #169918, #169759, #169783) Thanks @Yolo521-bot, @bautrey, and @RomneyDa.
- **Turns survive restarts:** interrupted turns, subagent work, automation turns, steered sessions, and node-hosted turns resume after a Gateway restart, and streamed replies from a killed worker stay in history. (#168650, #169144, #170162, #170252, #170161, #170223)
- **Telegram never replays old updates:** the first start after updating no longer re-dispatches months-old Telegram updates from the legacy spool as new owner instructions. (#170068, #169784) Thanks @angeliti999.
- **Codex and provider replies complete:** Codex replies keep their last tokens and accept follow-ups after a failed thread preparation, ChatGPT turns retry a mid-stream WebSocket close, and DeepSeek tool markup no longer leaks into messages. (#168400, #169431, #167512, #167345, #169728, #159665) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jjjhenriksen, @ericcurtin, @obviyus, @mightyx, and @TOMUIV.
- **Meta Muse Wonder:** Meta users can select `meta/muse-wonder-1.0` with tools, image input, streaming, reasoning controls, and a 1M-token context window. (#170232) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Plugin SDK compatibility:** plugins built against 2026.10.1 and 2026.10.2 can import `createSessionHeaderLink` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/control-ui` again. (#169746) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- **Meta Muse Wonder:** adds `meta/muse-wonder-1.0` with text and image input, tools, streaming, encrypted reasoning replay, and a 1,048,576-token context window; Spark remains the onboarding default. (#170232) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Device joins:** the CLI and Control UI join command now installs a background node service that can host agent sessions (`--service --session-host`), with a command-only service alternative, and already-paired devices get a working command to enable session hosting. (#168623) Thanks @obviyus.

### Fixes

- **Telegram:** legacy spool updates older than 24 hours are imported as stale and never dispatched, so already-handled messages are not executed again after an update. (#170068, #169784) Thanks @angeliti999.
- **Plugin SDK compatibility:** `createSessionHeaderLink` is restored in `openclaw/plugin-sdk/control-ui` as a deprecated export for plugins built against 2026.10.1 and 2026.10.2. (#169746) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Reply delivery:** streamed text from a killed native worker stays in history with its real failure, steered messages behind subagent announcements are no longer dropped as interrupted, blocking questions from routed agent turns reach their conversation, live sends survive delivery recovery, WebChat no longer shows false attachment errors or duplicate file cards, Talk consultations no longer abort right after connecting, and deleting a session records its cancellation before draining retained replies. (#170223, #168077, #170039, #169010, #169093, #170083) Thanks @RomneyDa and @brokemac79.
- **Restart recovery:** turns interrupted while a session was still preparing resume after a restart, interrupted subagents return to their parent with their history, automation turns, steered sessions, and node-hosted turns resume instead of failing with an active turn claim, a Gateway restarts cleanly when a stored cloud worker's machine is gone, and symlinked state directories keep working after a restart. (#168650, #169144, #170162, #170252, #170161, #168907, #168361) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Nodes and channels:** node requests and events no longer fail with "pairing changed" during another device's pairing activity, and channel tools keep working after a config write restarts the account. (#169486, #169575, #159396) Thanks @ceckert and @RomneyDa.
- **macOS app:** fresh app installs authenticate to their app-hosted Gateway and finish setup faster, and the Gateway reconnects automatically after a trusted TLS certificate renewal. (#169403, #168151)
- **Codex and OpenAI:** Codex replies keep their final tokens when a stream drops the last delta, Codex follow-ups work after a failed thread preparation, ChatGPT turns retry a mid-stream WebSocket close with code 1000, and personal-account quota rechecks no longer abort replies. (#168400, #169431, #167512, #167345, #170065) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jjjhenriksen, @ericcurtin, @obviyus, and @mightyx.
- **Models and providers:** DeepSeek tool-call markup is recovered instead of leaking into messages, Claude CLI sessions call registered OpenClaw tools by their MCP names, providers that never send response headers time out, agent runs honor the provider's live thinking levels without reloading catalogs, LM Studio refresh discovers new models, llama.cpp setup keeps aliased models and fails when credentials cannot be saved, and guarded model requests fall back to IPv6. (#169728, #159665, #153032, #168282, #168566, #168039, #150262, #168232, #168973, #87763) Thanks @TOMUIV, @kiranvk-2011, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @jb-lopez, @an2in, and @georgenaz.
- **MiniMax:** M3.1 models honor their thinking effort levels, and MiniMax OAuth sign-ins refresh expired tokens instead of failing about two hours after login. (#160089, #160037, #160459, #77467) Thanks @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @masatohoshino, and @rongtianhua.
- **ACP and compaction:** ACP agents keep plugin and OpenClaw tools when acpx is installed as a separate package, and the next turn after native compaction no longer fails while the transcript projection rebuilds. (#164272, #164211, #169583) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @obviyus, and @ajmtrz.
- **Automations:** manual runs keep tool access after the starting turn ends, cron no longer holds the state writer while waiting on the host so updates do not fail with a locked database, and a one-shot automation that fails terminally now sends a failure notice instead of disabling silently. (#168037, #168291) Thanks @obviyus.
- **pnpm and platform updates:** pnpm 12 Gateway services and `openclaw` launchers stay on the durable install link after updates, Windows updates accept qualified Scheduled Task account names and no longer roll back when Doctor re-checks ancestry, macOS updates accept protected Bun service commands, and clean service-install refusals stay recoverable. (#170003, #169059, #170131, #169244, #169481, #169563, #170006, #169662, #169658) Thanks @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @RomneyDa, and @jokerman1302-eng.
- **Update recovery:** package-activation journals settle after filesystem remounts and device-number drift, retained updater runtimes outside `node_modules` are reclaimed and never hard-link recovery files, upgrades keep state ownership across the heartbeat transition, and update-time Doctor keeps its child identities after a failed custody binding. (#169410, #170046, #169050, #169352, #170170, #169463, #169915, #169665) Thanks @patrickschiller, @RomneyDa, @SergeiAug, @Warhangel, and @vincentkoc.
- **Update outcomes:** updates with a running Gateway no longer record false post-install failures after migration, unsafe Doctor recovery guidance is kept until settled, candidate bookkeeping no longer makes older updaters refuse their config repair, and Doctor cleanup during updates no longer fails with nested-effect errors. (#170130, #169422, #170207, #170195, #170070, #168750) Thanks @angeliti999, @hannesrudolph, and @ezimerman.
- **Update database contention:** updates ride out a briefly locked state database, update history writes no longer stall Gateway cron and cleanup, and Doctor recovery captures stay stable while shared-state workers remain open. (#168210, #169283, #170022) Thanks @DonnieFi.
- **Doctor data safety:** Doctor keeps OAuth profiles when the legacy auth store is unreadable, refuses retired state before migrating the database, imports retained ACP metadata after archiving legacy session stores, restores a stopped Gateway when cleanup fails, and removes the `(multiple)` store sentinel registered as an agent database. (#170256, #168959, #170051, #169918, #169759, #169783, #170043, #169764) Thanks @Yolo521-bot, @bautrey, @RomneyDa, and @ourcoms2018.
- **oc-path:** `openclaw path set` refuses malformed UTF-8 before writing, preserving the file's bytes. (#168491) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666 and @Takhoffman.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.5-beta.2..463017d7dfa5fcbcb6fff97f32c17e09267c2b5a history: 71 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 71 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

name: openclaw 2026.10.3
body:
## 2026.10.3

### Highlights

- Updates that were stuck behind lost leases, completed-but-unrecognized receipts, or legacy 2026.9.8 activation records now recover and finish instead of refusing every retry. (#168388, #169038, #169027, #170195, #170170) Thanks @k94118, @mkdelta221, @waynegault, @chedong, and @Warhangel.
- Windows, macOS, and pnpm updates no longer leave the Gateway stopped or roll back: machine-qualified task accounts, short-name install paths, Doctor ancestry re-checks, protected Bun service commands, and pnpm 12 launchers all keep working. (#169481, #169292, #169563, #170006, #170003, #170131) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jokerman1302-eng, @xilopaint, and @k-sekula.
- Doctor no longer destroys data during repair: unreadable legacy auth keeps OAuth profiles, malformed UTF-8 memory files stay byte-exact, and blocked plugins keep their enabled state. (#170256, #169029, #168111) Thanks @Yolo521-bot, @wangmiao0668000666, and @obviyus.
- The "On this Mac" first run on a fresh Mac authenticates the app-hosted Gateway instead of failing with "Gateway rejected auth", and the Mac app reconnects after a trusted certificate renewal. (#169403, #168151)
- Chat-requested updates and plugin upgrades no longer roll back during Doctor cleanup, and stale Codex runtimes no longer break turns after an update. (#170218, #170306, #170339) Thanks @RomneyDa, @hannesrudolph, and @ezimerman.
- Agent turns are more reliable: the next turn after native compaction, ChatGPT WebSocket closes mid-stream, switching back to OpenAI without the Codex plugin, and Codex follow-ups after failed thread preparation all succeed. (#169583, #167512, #169412, #169431) Thanks @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @mightyx, @jjjhenriksen, and @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- Meta: Muse Wonder is available as a model. (#170232) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- MiniMax: M3.1 models honor the selected thinking effort level, and OAuth sign-ins refresh expired tokens at the issuing regional endpoint instead of failing about two hours after login. (#160089, #160459) Thanks @NianJiuZst, @php737, @masatohoshino, and @rongtianhua.

### Fixes

- Doctor: keep canonical OAuth profiles when the legacy auth store is unreadable or malformed instead of deleting them. (#170256) Thanks @Yolo521-bot.
- Doctor: never rewrite root memory files with replacement characters, and reject malformed UTF-8 before `path set` writes an edited file. (#169029, #168491) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666 and @Takhoffman.
- Doctor: preserve installed plugins when path-safety checks block them instead of stripping their `enabled` flag when run as root. (#168111) Thanks @obviyus.
- Doctor: include Canvas and Memory Core files in recovery copies, keep captures stable while workers stay open, honor Windows permissions for SQLite recovery snapshots, and stop spurious backups for unchanged one-shot cron jobs. (#169436, #169516, #170022, #169397, #168938) Thanks @RomneyDa, @harshitgupta31415, and @WG-Mojo.
- Updates: recover blocked updates after receipt identity drift, lost handoff leases, legacy package metadata drift, and FreeBSD package recovery refusals. (#168388, #169038, #169027, #168775) Thanks @k94118, @mkdelta221, @waynegault, and @chedong.
- Updates: older updaters no longer refuse candidates over bookkeeping-only config changes, and npm recovery reclaims retained runtimes that blocked it. (#170195, #170170) Thanks @Warhangel.
- Updates: keep the real failure when git-update cleanup reporting is unavailable, route migrated-no-rollback failures to `openclaw update repair`, and stop reporting successful handoffs as failures. (#169454, #168993) Thanks @sayitfast and @RomneyDa.
- Updates: clear repaired migration warnings, tolerate clock jumps during verification, and name the database and reason in capture and config-read warnings. (#169004, #169282, #169284) Thanks @WG-Mojo and @DonnieFi.
- Updates: preserve the service heap limit in update processes, stop copying unrelated parent dependencies, and keep npm-global updates from retaining unrelated global packages. (#168889, #168927, #169551) Thanks @bluet, @RomneyDa, and @holgergruenhagen.
- Updates: ride out briefly locked state databases, keep update-history writes from stalling Gateway cron and cleanup, and prevent false ownership loss during upgrades. (#168210, #169283, #169915) Thanks @DonnieFi and @vincentkoc.
- Updates: Doctor handles unreadable supervisors and child binding errors, clean service-install refusals stay out of native-authority recovery, and `openclaw update repair` no longer reports success when Doctor maintenance was skipped. (#169665, #169658, #167714)
- Windows: recognize machine-qualified Scheduled Task accounts, keep updater workers on short-name or miscased install paths, and stop rollbacks from Doctor ancestry re-checks. (#169481, #169292, #169563) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- macOS: unblock updates with protected Bun service commands, authenticate the app-hosted first run, and renew learned TLS pins on automatic reconnects. (#170006, #169403, #168151) Thanks @jokerman1302-eng.
- pnpm: keep Gateway service commands on the durable install link and keep pnpm 12 launchers working after native updates. (#170003, #170131) Thanks @xilopaint and @k-sekula.
- Plugins: preserve webhook listeners during deferred plugin upgrades, unblock repairs while data migrations are pending, and stop stale Codex runtimes breaking turns after updates. (#169035, #170339, #170306) Thanks @sirius1024 and @RomneyDa.
- Plugins: catalog refreshes no longer retain duplicate native plugin graphs and recover their config after a failed native ESM refresh. (#169272, #169321) Thanks @obviyus and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway: Claude CLI session tools keep working after the turn that started the MCP loopback ends, and channel tools no longer fail with stale caller authority after a config write restarts the account. (#165432, #159396) Thanks @Oldrich333, @Leit-motif, @ceckert, and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway: node requests and events no longer fail with "pairing changed" after unrelated pairing activity or while another device's pairing is written. (#169486, #169575)
- Gateway: restart cleanly when a stored cloud worker's machine is gone, preserve live sends during outbound queue recovery, and resume steered sessions after restart. (#168907, #169010, #170252) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Agents: prevent next-turn failures after native compaction without loading entire large transcripts. (#169583, #108851) Thanks @obviyus.
- Models: switching back to an OpenAI model works when the Codex plugin is disabled, and model selections without an activatable harness are rejected. (#169412, #134837) Thanks @obviyus and @goslingmanagment.
- OpenAI: turns no longer fail when the ChatGPT WebSocket closes with code 1000 mid-stream. (#167512) Thanks @ericcurtin, @obviyus, and @mightyx.
- Codex: recover follow-up requests after failed thread preparation. (#169431) Thanks @jjjhenriksen and @RomneyDa.
- Networking: guarded model requests fall back to IPv6 when IPv4 is unreachable, keeping SSRF validation. (#168973) Thanks @an2in and @georgenaz.
- Copilot: honor reported context capacity when native limits are missing. (#156636) Thanks @saju01 and @RomneyDa.
- Anthropic: guide Claude CLI to the registered OpenClaw tools. (#153032) Thanks @kiranvk-2011.
- DeepSeek: recover `calls` markup instead of leaking tool payloads into replies. (#169728) Thanks @TOMUIV.
- Release: first-hop update coverage admits sources by schema version, failed receipts recover without rerunning workloads, and upgrade diagnostics keep failing steps. (#169012, #168266, #165267, #169567, #169084, #168191, #165968, #164789, #168097) Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.2..8dd1ada0a3c166b77c7b671847a1752200e7f2c1 history: 79 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 79 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.
